description: Look up what a WebSocket frame opcode means per RFC 6455: 0x0-0x2 are data frames (continuation, text, binary), 0x8-0xA are control frames (close, ping, pong), and the rest of the 4-bit opcode space is reserved for future protocol revisions.

opcode.description: The WebSocket frame opcode to look up (0-15 / 0x0-0xF)

name: lookup_websocket_opcode
